propositions: BindingStore must be refactored by extracting persistence, tempfile management, JSON encoding, and rotation logic into a private BindingRepository unit-of-work while preserving the public facade unchanged
Repository must load legacy records and unknown fields, preserve exact byte-for-byte serialization on round-trip, and apply no eager rewrites

Each named fault scenario (tempfile, rotation replace, retired replace, live replace, alert write) must produce the same raise/swallow/alert behavior and surviving file state as the original implementation
GET rotation must durably attempt before live replacement, with failed sidecar saves retaining the inline floor and later retries converging
Tickets publication must stage only the existing five bridge-state files with no commit on unchanged pass
The binding-lifecycle ADR must document repository ownership, ordered partial-state recovery behavior, selective publication seam, and the rejection of journal and format-migration approaches
